newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Prudential NZ's premium product sales rise 34 pct.
newsitem.headline: Prudential NZ's premium product sales rise 34 pct.

text.p: A rise of more than 50 percent in retail superannuation plan sales led to an overall rise of 34 percent in sales of Prudential New Zealand's regular premium products in 1996, the firm said on Tuesday.
Regular premium sales exceeded NZ$30 million for the first time, and single premium sales rose sharply to $46 million, producing total premium income of more than $76 million in 1996.
The increase also took Prudential's in-force regular premium business to more than $117 million by the end of last year.
Molloy said he expected further improvement in a number of areas this year as a result of the initiatives.

Retail superannuation sales in 1996 rose sharply to almost $16.6 million of annual premium income. The number of superannuation plans sold rose to almost 8,000, and the level of contributions increased.
Corporate superannuation and risk business also rose signficantly, Molloy said.
